title: Find the client IDs of male clients born between 1970 and 1975 who are not
question: Find the client IDs of male clients born between 1970 and 1975 who are not account owners, live in districts where unemployment increased from 1995 to 1996, and have at least one transaction of type 'VYDAJ' (withdrawal) with an amount exceeding $5000.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_009"
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c."XCL_012" = d."XCL_017"
JOIN disp dp ON c."XCL_009" = dp."XCL_014"
JOIN account a ON dp."XCL_015" = a."XCL_001"
JOIN trans t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
WHERE c."XCL_010" = 'M'
  AND c."XCL_011" BETWEEN '1970-01-01' AND '1975-12-31'
  AND dp."XCL_016" != 'OWNER'
  AND d."XCL_029" > d."XCL_028"
  AND t."XCL_049" = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t."XCL_051" > 5000
